title: Tuxedos for night-spot work
summary: Musicians wore tuxedos because contracts required it; Howard did not need to change when he joined Oliver.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I do. I do. I do. I do. Did Oliver wear tuxedos from the beginning?
Did Oliver's band wear tuxedos from the beginning?

In those days tuxedos were very essential. In those days most musicians did wear them. I don't care what kind of job you had. Because you see the contract called, you were paid to wear them. You understand that, don't you?
Sure. You presumably wore one the first night he opened then.
Well I went down there and I said what are you wearing? Tuxedo. I didn't have to do no change. I just went around and put the same tuxedo on and went to work.
When you worked at that after-arts place, at the Dreamland. Yes. What did you wear there?
